name: fitness
description: 苹果风格的可编辑健身打卡日历，周/月/年视图，部署在 Cloudflare Workers，支持服务端合并同步与机器人渠道打卡，并接入阿里 page-agent 做每周/每月健身频次分析。

scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/analysis.test.js test/store.test.js test/worker.test.js test/edge.test.js test/items.test.js test/merge.test.js test/append.test.js test/interaction.test.js test/sw.test.js test/perf.test.js
scripts.check: node --check public/app.js && node --check public/analysis.js && node --check public/store.js && node --check src/worker.js
scripts.test:py: python3 -m pytest test/test_plugin.py test/test_insight.py test/test_concurrency.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
